ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.FxForwardInstrumentDefinition

Creates the Cross Currency curve definition with the definition provided.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.FxForwardInstrumentDefinition.

Syntax

FxForwardInstrumentDefinition(
    *,
    instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    tenor: OptStr = None,
    quotation_mode: QuotationMode | None = None,
    is_non_deliverable: OptBool = None,
    synthetic_instrument_code: OptStr = None,
    template: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
instrument_code OptStr No None The code used to define the instrument.
tenor OptStr No None The code indicating the instrument tenor (e.g., '6m', '1y').
quotation_mode QuotationMode | None No None The quotation defining the price type of the instrument. the possible values are: * swappoint * outright
is_non_deliverable OptBool No None True if the instrument is non deliverable
synthetic_instrument_code OptStr No None The code used to define the formula.
template OptStr No None A reference to a style used to define the instrument.

Properties

Property Description
instrument_code The code used to define the instrument.
is_non_deliverable True if the instrument is non deliverable
quotation_mode The quotation defining the price type of the instrument. the possible values are: * swappoint * outright
synthetic_instrument_code The code used to define the formula.
template A reference to a style used to define the instrument.
tenor The code indicating the instrument tenor (e.g., '6m', '1y').
